blocks.text: BEREAVEMENT CLEANOUT FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions About Bereavement Cleanout Services in Scarborough

items.q: How soon after a death do you need to book a bereavement cleanout?
a: Whenever feels right for your family — there’s no deadline with us. Some families call within days; others wait months.

items.q: My parents' home has decades of belongings in it — is that going to be more than expected?
a: Possibly, and that’s genuinely normal for original homes across Agincourt, Woburn, Cedarbrae and Malvern. We scope the real volume honestly at the walkthrough rather than assuming, and price accordingly.

items.q: Is our property too close to the Bluffs or a ravine for bereavement cleanout?
a: Not necessarily, but it does call for extra care. Work stays inside the approved footprint, and anything touching a protected slope gets flagged for approvals first.

items.q: Can you set aside sentimental items before clearing the rest?
a: Yes — always. We never remove anything you’ve identified as something to keep, and we’re happy to pause or revisit a room if you need more time.

items.q: Do you work with executors and estate lawyers?
a: Yes — we regularly coordinate directly with executors, family lawyers and estate trustees.

items.q: Can you handle a bereavement cleanout in a condo near Scarborough Town Centre?
a: Yes, and it’s handled by the building’s book — COIs filed, freight elevators reserved ahead.

items.q: How much does a bereavement cleanout cost in Scarborough?
a: Pricing is volume-based and starts from $125 for smaller spaces, confirmed free at a private walkthrough.

items.q: What if the property has safety hazards — pests, mould, structural damage?
a: Those get flagged honestly. Live Junk Free doesn’t disturb suspected biohazards or structural issues — the concern is identified and the family is pointed toward the right licensed specialist.
